verdict.rationale: GitHub's own marketing says it lets you "organize everything from high-level roadmaps to everyday tasks" [github-docs-8], which matches the story almost word for word. It also says you can "create issues and manage projects" [github-docs-12], including from mobile [github-docs-4]. All of this is homepage marketing, so the evidence is thin. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of project boards (board/roadmap views, fields, task hierarchy), explicit mention of 'boards' as the mechanism, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
